text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to limit sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly. Even a short walk every day can help. Third, get enough sleep, about seven to eight hours each night. Good sleep gives you energy and helps you think clearly. Don't forget mental health. Talk to friends, relax, and take breaks when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a healthy work-life balance. Make time for both work and fun. These simple habits can make you feel happier and stronger.
